Limitations and interpretation

  • The dataset is observational (14 ears); statements are descriptive of this study sample and are not population estimates.
  • The subject is the independent statistical unit; reinsertions are technical repeats and are averaged within subject before inference.
  • Measured NaNs are excluded and structurally invalid entries are masked; no value is imputed anywhere in the pipeline.
  • Thresholds are quantised to 1 dB, limiting the resolution of threshold-based effect estimates.
  • Transfer-function levels refer to the fixed 11.2 mV receiver drive; they are not an in-situ speech level or a prescribed gain target.
  • Figures and tables are reproduced from persisted artefacts and may lag behind a newer data file or a newer experiment run.
  • Inferential settings: alpha = 0.05, holm correction, 10000 bootstrap resamples, confidence 95%.
